== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Reader burn is a physical and mental affliction experienced by [[Readers]] when they overextend their abilities or attempt to manipulate [[Intent]] that exceeds their personal constitution. The condition manifests as intense cranial pain, often described as a throbbing sensation, a crushing feeling, or an internal drilling. Some individuals compare the sensation to swallowing snow or experiencing a severe headache that can lead to nosebleeds. If a Reader continues to push their limits while suffering from this condition, the pain can become debilitating enough to knock them unconscious or render them useless. The severity of the burn is often linked to the strength of the [[Intent]] being processed, such as when a Reader attempts to interact with powerful [[Imperial relics]] or the direct essence of [[Elders]], which can lead to insanity.}}
